task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Draft the comprehensive 疫情防控 memorial (piaoni): propose imperial edict codifying the response, define ministry operational remits, set funding ceiling, quarantine policy, and termination triggers; circulate for Grand Secretariat consensus before submission

Secure the Emperor's vermillion endorsement (pihong) on the memorial, formally promulgate the 防疫敕令 as binding edict, and relay imperial instructions back to the Six Ministries as the authoritative channel

Open the 疫癘救濟專銀 emergency treasury, release 常平倉 granary reserves, procure medicine (藥材) and coffins through licensed merchants, audit silver flows weekly, and cap grain/medicine prices to prevent hoarding

Deploy 京營 and regional guards to enforce quarantine cordons around infected wards, escort medical supply convoys between provinces, seal major city gates per the edict, and protect isolation teams from unrest

Construct 隔離疫房 (isolation wards) and 漏澤園 (mass burial grounds) outside city walls, repair roads and waterways for supply transport, and requisition timber/lime under the emergency construction mandate

Promulgate the 瘟疫條例: mandate household reporting of deaths, criminalize concealment of infection and price gouging on medicine, prosecute rumor-mongers, and establish a 御史臺 cross-audit channel against corruption

Dispatch civil officials (知縣/知府) to coordinate prefecture-level response, mobilize 醫學訓科 medical personnel, staff quarantine stations with rotating civil servants, and maintain census/registry accuracy for mortality tracking

Conduct state 祈禳疫癘 sacrifices at the 天地壇 and ancestral temples for legitimacy, coordinate with Confucian temple networks for moral exhortation, and oversee Buddhist/Taoist charitable almshouses that supplement medical relief
